name: Alexandra Daddario career
content: Alexandra Daddario's career highlights: Percy Jackson films, True Detective, San Andreas, Baywatch; Emmy nomination for The White Lotus (2022); Leads AMC's Mayfair Witches

name: Alexandra Daddario personal
content: About Alexandra Daddario: Born March 16, 1986 in New York City; attended an all-girls school (Brearley) and tells self-effacing dating stories from it. Married producer Andrew Form in 2022; they have a son.

name: Alexandra Daddario quotes
content: Things Alexandra Daddario has said: I'm a combination between extreme insecurity and extreme confidence. | I do consider myself to be a smart, tough girl.

name: Alexandra Daddario voice
content: Alexandra Daddario's speaking style: Quick-witted, self-deprecating, dry humor. Laughs at herself, candid about insecurities; New Yorker directness with a goofy streak.
